note.zh-TW: 與法定稅率不符時提示屬教學設定（T10）。
note.en: When it differs from the statutory rate the site notes that the rate is a teaching assumption (T10).

definition.zh-TW: 所得稅費用占稅前淨利的比例，也就是公司實際負擔的稅率。它和法定稅率不一定相同。
definition.en: Income tax expense as a share of profit before tax: the tax rate the company actually bears. It need not equal the statutory rate.

ifrsNote.zh-TW: IFRS 不把它當成報表列；IAS 12.86 在附註揭露中稱它為平均有效稅率。
ifrsNote.en: IFRS does not treat it as a statement line; IAS 12.86 calls it the average effective tax rate in the note disclosures.
